// admin-react/src/pages/Roles&Teams/Agents/components/AgentModal.jsx import { useEffect, useState } from 'react' import XMarkIcon from '@heroicons/react/24/outline/XMarkIcon' import UserIcon from '@heroicons/react/24/outline/UserIcon' function AgentModal({ open, agent, onClose, onSubmit, }) { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ name: '', phone: '', email: '', status: 'Active', }) const [error, setError] = useState('') useEffect(() => { if (agent) { setFormData({ name: agent.name || '', phone: agent.phone || '', email: agent.email || '', status: agent.status || 'Active', }) } else { setFormData({ name: '', phone: '', email: '', status: 'Active', }) } setError('') }, [agent, open]) if (!open) { return null } const handleChange = (event) => { const { name, value } = event.target setFormData((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value, })) setError('') } const handleSubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault() const name = formData.name.trim() const phone = formData.phone.trim() const email = formData.email.trim() if (!name) { setError('Agent name is required.') return } if (name.length < 2) { setError('Agent name must contain at least 2 characters.') return } if (!phone) { setError('Phone number is required.') return } if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(phone)) { setError('Please enter a valid 10-digit phone number.') return } if (!email) { setError('Email address is required.') return } if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { setError('Please enter a valid email address.') return } onSubmit?.({ name, phone, email, status: formData.status, }) } return (
